title: Easy flat + mobility
coachNotes: Valley floor only, no climbing, no descent. Saturday is now the single confirmed weather window of the whole weekend and it carries the last real vertical before the race, so today exists only to keep the legs open. Thirty minutes, flat, conversational, stop early if it feels like work. This is also the second and final ITB checkpoint for Saturday: 48h after Wednesday's descent is exactly when a developing band problem announces itself. Clean this morning and Saturday goes at 1000m D+ / load 155. Any lateral knee signal and Saturday drops to 800m D+ and load 110, decided this evening, not on the trail. If HRV is under 52 or the 7-day/28-day ratio drops below 0.90, take full rest instead of this jog, it costs nothing.
